about_the_game:
The modern, efficient and flashy MP36 diesels have been operating on Peninsula Corridor express services since 2003, and now you can experience them for yourself in Train Sim World!

If a diesel locomotive can, at once, be both stylish and rather brutish, the MP36PH-3C fits the bill. Packing 3,600-horsepower and constructed to stringent crash worthiness standards, the MP36PH-3C stretches to 70-feet in length, stands 15-and-a-half feet tall, weighs in at more than 280,000 pounds – and yet manages a sleek, rather European-style visual panache.

Introduced in 2002, the MPXpress line of diesel locomotives largely became the standard-bearer for commuter motive power in North America. Six MP36PH-3C variants were ordered for use on Peninsula Corridor express commuter services. Dressed in a red, white, and black livery and wearing road numbers 923-928, the MP36PH-3Cs entered service in 2003 and have now worked for two decades on the Peninsula.

In Train Sim World, the MP36PH-3C makes its debut on the Peninsula Corridor, twinned with Bi-Level commuter equipment perfectly suited for express services through the Bay Area. Race southbound from the uniquely futuristic cab of the MP36, and be pushed on the return to San Francisco from the immersive Cab Car.

Please note: Peninsula Corridor: San Francisco - San Jose Route Add-On is required, as a separate purchase, in order to utilise the content featured in this add-on.

Key Features


  • MP36PH-3C Diesel Locomotive
  • Bi-Level Cars and Cab Car
  • Accurate, true-to-life performance and handling
  • Highly detailed, feature-rich, driving cabs with accurate true-to-life performance and handling
  • Authentic and detailed sound recordings, recorded from the real locomotives
  • Includes three engaging scenarios and two interactive training modules for Peninsula Corridor
  • Operable in Timetable Mode on Peninsula Corridor
  • Powered by Dovetail Games’ proprietary SimuGraph® vehicle dynamics engine and Unreal Engine 4® technology
  • Download size: 217.5 MB
